title: Deadline District
description: Three.js browser sniper game featuring procedurally seeded city environments, contracts, ballistics, vehicles, weather, customizable mobile controls, optional multiplayer and offline PWA support. Includes simulation tests, Playwright checks and rendering budgets.
features: Procedurally seeded three-dimensional environments with contracts and progression
Ballistics, scoped weapons, vehicle physics, weather and pedestrian simulation
Optional cooperative multiplayer, mobile controls and offline PWA support
Automated simulation tests, browser end-to-end checks and rendering performance budgets
workflow: Generate a deterministic city, contract and environment
Run game-state simulation and render with Three.js
Process player input, scoring, progression and optional multiplayer state
Persist progress and export shareable gameplay highlights
